source.filename: G.R.F. Dalley & Partners - Website Requirements Specification (2).docx

requirements.acceptance: Cryptware will update website content on request using materials supplied by the Firm
requirements.assessment: Structured content files and documented Cryptware update workflow; no CMS required. Future support response times/costs are outside this test.

requirements.acceptance: An insight can be assigned an author; published insights appear in the Insights section and on the author's profile
requirements.assessment: Author/profile links work for all three historical references. Final firm approval and complete supplied publication content/relationships remain outstanding.

requirements.acceptance: Content can be associated with relevant industries and practice areas; relationships appear as links on relevant pages
requirements.assessment: Stable IDs resolve and reciprocal editorial links render. The firm must approve final relationship/content choices; editorial browsing connections are not claims of past matters.

requirements.acceptance: Profiles use a consistent template and display only the fields supplied and approved for each person
requirements.assessment: Eight source-checked profiles/portraits render and search works. Current roster, roles, credentials and final firm publication approval remain unconfirmed.

requirements.acceptance: Visitors can open individual insights from a listing; each detail page displays metadata, content, author, practice and industry
requirements.assessment: Listing/detail templates, historical dates, authors and supported relationships work. Only three verified external references are supplied; missing legal article bodies/media must not be fabricated.

requirements.acceptance: Visitors can submit an enquiry through a validated form and receive on-screen confirmation; submissions route to the Firm's designated recipient
requirements.assessment: Validation, errors, mailto fallback and mocked secure adapter pass. No authorized delivery credentials or inbox-receipt test; real delivery is not passed.

requirements.acceptance: Visitors can request a consultation through a form or book directly through an online calendar (Calendly); submissions route to the Firm's designated recipient
requirements.assessment: Consultation form and consent-gated calendar adapter are tested with fixtures. Real mail delivery and approved Calendly URL are missing; no appointment was booked.

requirements.acceptance: Navigation, forms, content and key actions remain usable on mobile, tablet and desktop viewports
requirements.assessment: DOM mobile-menu/keyboard and responsive CSS checks pass at tested widths. No Chrome/Firefox/Safari/Edge or real mobile layout session was available.

requirements.acceptance: Confirmed: visitors can filter or search People and Insights listings by category, practice area and author
requirements.assessment: People name/practice search and Insights category/author/industry/practice filters, combined queries, pagination, URL persistence and empty states pass local tests.

requirements.acceptance: Only approved and published content is publicly visible on the website
requirements.assessment: Publication gates hide drafts and production launch is blocked. Current requester-authorized copy is not final firm approval; full strict contractual acceptance awaits firm sign-off.

requirements.acceptance: Agreed page and content types support editable page titles, meta descriptions, URL slugs and image alt text
requirements.assessment: Independently reviewed title/description/portrait-alt fields, editable slugs and static-page overrides now exist. Local metadata tests pass; approved canonical origin and live release SEO checks remain missing.

requirements.acceptance: LinkedIn, external publication and video links can be added to relevant content and profiles
requirements.assessment: Seven supplied LinkedIn URLs, three external publications and two maps are present. HTTP reachability was checked, but provider refusals block some browser verification. Approved video assets and the actual Calendly URL are still missing; fixture embed tests are not end-to-end acceptance.
